response.sql: SELECT l.ID, AVG(l.UA) as avg_ua, AVG(l.HCT) as avg_hct FROM Laboratory l WHERE l.ID NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE RA = '-') GROUP BY l.ID ORDER BY AVG(l.HCT) IS NULL, AVG(l.HCT) DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: "Patients without a rheumatoid factor result of '-'" excludes entire patients who have any RA = '-' record (patient-level filtering), rather than filtering only individual records where RA != '-'

alternatives.interpretation: Filter records where RA is not '-' (record-level filtering), rather than excluding entire patients. A patient with some RA = '-' records and some RA = '+' records would be included in the averages calculated only from the non-'-' records.
alternatives.sql: SELECT l.ID, AVG(l.UA) as avg_ua, AVG(l.HCT) as avg_hct FROM Laboratory l WHERE l.RA IS NULL OR l.RA <> '-' GROUP BY l.ID ORDER BY AVG(l.HCT) IS NULL, AVG(l.HCT) DESC LIMIT 10;
